notes: All 9 source IDs and 19 target tokens are partitioned exactly once.

*the eyes of* is correctly one `added` unit rather than three: the words are contiguous, they do the single office of supplying an object head noun for the English verb, and rule 2 places such a run as one unit headed on the word carrying its force. `פָּקַח`'s lexeme is already written by *openeth*, so the supplied noun carries none of it (rule 44's supplied-object-noun clause, as `לֹא שָׁאָלוּ` → *asked counsel not* leaves *counsel* `added`). The ASV italics corroborate and decide nothing (rule 7); the competing reading, folding the run into the verb as part of an idiomatic rendering, is named in the unit note.

*raiseth up* and *bowed down* keep their particles with the verbs whose lexemes they complete (rule 44); the *them that are* of `כְּפוּפִים` is rule 46's supplied noun phrase with rule 20's copula, headed on *bowed*.
Each colon writes its own subject, so no participle here takes a supplied relative.
